entry: First package only; exact YouTube or Music package identity. Each process takes exactly one host startup path.

policy.reply: Only native status zero and exactly one output byte 01 authorize an effect. Every other reply preserves native behavior.

preferences.storage: Music's own Context; independent of YouTube's preferences
preferences.snapshot: Existing Brainfuck settings_snapshot, exactly nine bytes
preferences.startup: Effects disabled until Instrumentation.callApplicationOnCreate supplies an attached Context and a valid BF snapshot; UI changes publish another snapshot.

discovery.video_anchor: maybeRegenerateCpnAndStatsClient called unexpectedly, but no error.
discovery.video_role: Unique void one-argument anchored method, then its unique invoked method with descriptor suffix (Z)V; fewer than 512 invoked methods
discovery.failure: Missing or ambiguous roles leave that surface unchanged; hooks use protective exception mode
discovery.selectors: Semantic diagnostics, prototypes, platform API names and named resources; no obfuscated names or instruction offsets

compact.requirements: Prefix match at content index zero, unique typed serializer, current candidate's argument 2 payload only; never an ancestor buffer

video_effect: Call the original boolean activation method with false only when BF authorizes suppression; preserve the original call and its side effects otherwise, including native false arguments.
fullscreen: Existing bounded serialized _interstitial classification and BF ad_fullscreen policy; effective fullscreen switch includes the master.

settings.theme: Theme.YouTubeMusic resolved by name; no numeric host resource IDs
settings.presentation: Shared settings entry, dialog scaffold, section and toggle vocabulary; Music exposes ads only
settings.shared_dialog_state: Initialize existing UI holder slots 16 (page stack), 17 (UI check guard), 18 (dialog reference); no SponsorBlock player/network initialization
settings.ui_checks: Existing SponsorBlock color-picker checks run in YouTube only

out_of_scope: Upgrade tab and native Get Music Premium account/settings labels
native Premium bottom sheets without a recognized serialized ad payload
